name: Paludal-Playa
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the south, solar wind erosion patterns. Nothing wears any of it smooth.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Fossil beds suggest rich seas once flourished here; now the chemistry records only a slow suffocation.
Established during the last boom, the automated beacon of unknown purpose was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
For traders, aluminum alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
